I added a 0.25s sleep between sandbox calls in `tests/test_payments.py`:

- A new constant, `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL = 0.25`, with a comment noting the 5 requests/second limit. The minimum gap at that limit is 0.2s, so 0.25s leaves some headroom.
- The loop sleeps only *between* calls, not before the first one, so the test takes about 0.75s longer.

I didn't run the test because it's an integration test against the real sandbox.

I also saved the 5 requests/second sandbox limit to EngramDB as a hazard, so future tests that call the sandbox will see it.

If more tests start calling the sandbox, a small shared rate-limited helper or fixture would scale better than separate sleeps in each test. I can set that up if you want.
